caveats:
Numerous administrative level 4 features appear to have feature name discrepancies.  The "Admin4_EN_SI_Conflicts.xlsx" table lists the 530 features (from the 14,043 total) that belong to sets with identical English names (admin4Name_en) for which there are multiple Sinhalese name (admin4Name_si) variants.  It is presumed that at least one of the variants is wrong.

65 administrative level 4 features have unknown English names.

This dataset is structured into 4 levels:  
- Admin 1: 9   
- Admin 2: 25   
- Admin 3: 339   
- Admin 4: 14043
